safe._about: The safe-zone rule. Armagedom's equivalent (Web/src/engine/safehouse.js, data wholeArea:true) does four things: no hostile is ever placed in the area (its validator throws if a whole-area safehouse lists a resident), the player's weapon is lowered and swing/guard are cancelled, any hostile in range is suppressed (attacks stopped, goes home), and spawners (waves, marked hunters, raids) pause. Frankendom's hub is its own zone, so the boundary IS the zone: nothing alive from another zone exists here (laneZONES despawns the old zone's clones at the gate swap).

boundaryAlt._about: only if a camp is ever placed INSIDE a bigger zone (no such placement is planned): monsters may not enter radius + holdOff

chasers._about: laneCHASE (chase.json) lets Pitborn follow you through a gate. Into a safe zone that must be vetoed: the follower runs to the gate point, halts there, drops aggro and walks home (laneCHASE's give-up Home state), and the player is allowed through even while engaged. This differs from laneCHASE as shipped (a creature that cannot follow keeps the gate SHUT while engaged), so it needs one small hunk in ZoneRuntime CheckGates/DoSwap that reads the destination zone's safe flag. In the physical-span world (laneZONE2DUP) the same rule is the clamp at the zone boundaryZ.

monsters._about: stopAtBoundary: a living creature's goal point is clamped to the boundary (+ holdOff) and it holds there. leashReset = the laneZONES leash behaviour that already exists: drop aggro, heal to full, walk home. A gate swap with an engaged creature is already refused (zones.json crossing.allowWhileEngaged false) and the old zone's clones are despawned at the swap, so in the planned layout nothing can arrive; these lines are the belt to that braces.

combat._about: Armagedom lowers the weapon (g.weaponsLowered), cancels swing/guard/reload on entering and shows a status line. Dodge and walking stay on so movement feels the same. weaponDisplay lowered = hold the carried weapon in the idle pose (no sheath clip is owned; if that looks threatening, hide the weapon renderer through the equip slot, Unity dev decision).
combat._allowPress: press ids that stay allowed in the camp (dodges); copied from market.json safe.allowPress. damageToPlayer 0 = Duel.Resolve skips a strike on the player inside the camp (HubSafe.NoHit).

regen._about: no new numbers: a safe zone already refills to 100 % out of combat and the hearth refills at 8 %/s (zones.json hp)

spawners._about: Armagedom: no trap crates, no pickups, no airdrop, no share-clip in the hub. Here: no gear drops inside the camp.

safe._camp_note: CAMPSET: the camp rows stand outside the walk path (walk.halfWidth 1.1 around the centre line in camp_rows.json) so a player never snags on the camp.

indicator._about: How the player knows they are safe. Armagedom: area name 'Central Safehouse', a HUD status line while the weapon is lowered, a pulse on the interaction prop. Frankendom: five cues, all data.

npcRules._about: Alpha: idle only, no dialogue trees, no schedule, no pathing, no health, not targetable. Armagedom's hub NPCs are the same ('not entities: no health, collision, targeting, trade, healing, quest or save state', one Mixamo idle each with a phase offset so they do not move in unison).
npcRules._standIn: CAMPSET: idle_a/idle_b/idle_c all map to the owned Mixamo idle 113410901-idle.glb (or Idle inside joan_chef_v4.glb); phase offsets 0, 2.5, 5 s keep them out of step. No new clip was made.

stall._about: ONE sell-only stall behind laneTRADE's IMarketBackend (Stock, Trade(op,item,qty,requestId)). backend local = LocalMarket on LootSave; a later http backend changes nothing here. ops sell only: a buy request is answered 'not-for-sale' by the backend AND the panel shows no Buy tab. Enabled together with zones.json market_hub (both default off).

price._about: PLACEHOLDER balance numbers (Dom/balance decision). 0.33 is Armagedom's sell/buy ratio (sell 20/40/80 against buy 60/120/250). value = perArmor*armor + perPoise*poise + perKg*weight from gear.json stats, so gear.json needs no new field; sell = max(min, round(sellFrac*value)). Fixed, same for everyone, no depletion.

requestIds._about: idempotency: a repeated request id changes nothing (Armagedom's replay guard); persisted in LootSave v2 next to the coins

stall._buy: laneNPCSPAWN: buy side ON in this file (still dark: hub.json enabled false). Price = market.json rows buyValue x mul, at least minPrice. PLACEHOLDER stock and prices, Dom has not set them.

buy._about: items = gear ids (must be rows in market.json). One copy per id. Coins and the new item are written by ONE save (LootSave.CommitBuy); a repeated request id changes nothing.

spawner._about: NPC spawner. NPCs are spawned when the player is within spawnMarginM of the camp rectangle and the zones are live (ZoneRuntime.Owns + ZoneSpan.Live), removed past despawnMarginM (<= the span wake distance, so the camp is never paid for beside another zone). leaveMode destroy = free the bodies and their imports; sleep = SetActive(false), memory stays. One body loads at a time, framesBetweenLoads apart.
spawner._searchRoots: relative runtime.sources are tried under the project root ('') then its parent ('..' = Documents, where kits_out lives); StreamingAssets/<runtime.glb> is tried first.
spawner._yaw: yawOffsetDeg: if glTFast mirrors the facing, set 180 here and every NPC turns (one number, not three rows).
